text:
sam (oncall): Paging — seeing a 504 spike from hosted API in us-west-2, started ~5m ago. Health checks failing on frontend pool. Investigating.
maya (sre): looking at autoscaler logs and LB. Could be slow backend warmups after a small deploy.
sam (oncall): I rolled a small restart on frontend nodes, temporarily reduced concurrency for the route. Monitoring.
maya (sre): noticed a surge of keepalive timeouts to model-proxy; backend sluggish. Kicking a scale-up for the gpu-pool now.
lina (eng): FYI I just pushed a tiny change to model-proxy timeout handling — should be harmless but will pause further deploys until this stabilizes.
henry (pm): customer-impact check: any paid tenants affected? We have 3 active Dedicated customers in us-west-2; need to flag account ops if degraded.
sam (oncall): confirmed 2 Dedicated customers had elevated error rates (10-15% for ~8m). Logged in support ticket #SUP-783.
postmortem-bot: incident ticket INC-2200 created, severity S2, status investigating.
maya (sre): mitigation done — scaled up gpu-pool + reverted small deploy. Error rate dropping to baseline.
sam (oncall): marking incident resolved in pager duty. Quick notes: cause = backend warmup + slightly aggressive keepalive timeout; mitigations = scale up + revert.
henry (pm): let's schedule a post-incident review. Can we auto-generate the PM doc and create actionable remediation items? Prefer template with impact, timeline, owners, remediation SLA.
lina (eng): I can own a remediation task to add conservative connection backoff and a warmup probe. Estimate: 3d.
sam (oncall): agreed. Also want a follow-up to adjust alert thresholds to avoid noisy paging for short warmups.
henry (pm): propose remediation SLA 14 days for initial fix, 60 days for infra changes. Also want a short retro with ops and eng.
sam (oncall): can we have a bot flow that: on incident close -> creates PM stub in Notion, adds action items in actionboard, assigns owner if they opt-in, and sets reminders? Right now it's manual and slips.
remediation-bot: suggested command: `/remediate create --incident INC-2200 --template minimal --owner lina --sla 14d --followup "retro with ops"`
lina (eng): that command would save time. Also include a checkbox to auto-create Jira/Ticket in our action dashboard.
remediation-bot: created PM draft: https://notion.fake/INC-2200-draft (draft), created action REM-2200 assigned to lina, due 14d, set calendar reminder for 3d and 10d. Created dashboard card.
sam (oncall): thanks. Also can the bot add the oncall timeline snippet automatically? e.g., list of paging events, mitigations, deploy hashes.
postmortem-bot: added timeline hook. Use `/postmortem export-timeline INC-2200` to embed events.
henry (pm): scheduling retro: proposed 10:00am tomorrow, invite ops, eng oncall, and product. I'll own the calendar invite.
lina (eng): noted, will prepare remediation PR checklist, link to dashboard.
sam (oncall): follow-ups: 1) adjust keepalive defaults (lina) 2) alert threshold tweak (maya) 3) add bot flow for automatic PM + actions (henry).
henry (pm): assigned in actionboard: REM-2200 (lina), REM-2201 (maya), REM-2202 (henry) — setting due dates and watchers.
maya (sre): will draft alert threshold change and run it in canary for a week.
sam (oncall): final: please react with :+1: if you can attend tomorrow's retro and confirm ownerships.
lina (eng): :+1:
maya (sre): :+1:
henry (pm): :+1:
sam (oncall): closing thread — thanks everyone. We'll use the bot commands in future incidents to reduce manual follow-ups.
